title.en: Cursor removes malicious Claude Code extension builds from its marketplace
title.zhHans: Cursor 从扩展市场移除恶意 Claude Code 构建版本

searchSummary.en: Malicious versions of the Claude Code extension were available in Cursor’s marketplace for roughly 11 hours on October 29.
searchSummary.zhHans: 10 月 29 日，恶意 Claude Code 扩展版本在 Cursor 市场可获取约 11 小时。

summary.en: Cursor said modified Claude Code extension builds 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 were available through its marketplace for macOS and Windows from roughly 2:27 a.m. to 1:35 p.m. Pacific time on October 29. It removed the affected builds and shut down the marketplace during its response. StepSecurity separately analyzed malicious code added to a clean extension bundle. Cursor’s reported ceiling of 5,000 potentially affected users is not a count of compromised devices; credential theft or broader distribution is not established.
summary.zhHans: Cursor 称，10 月 29 日太平洋时间约凌晨 2:27 至下午 1:35，macOS 和 Windows 用户可从其扩展市场取得被修改的 Claude Code 扩展构建 2.1.312、2.1.313。公司随后移除相关版本，并在处置期间关闭市场。StepSecurity 独立分析了添加到正常扩展包中的恶意代码。Cursor 所称最多 5,000 名可能受影响用户不是已被入侵设备数量；现有证据也无法确定凭据已被窃取或其他发行渠道受影响。

narrative.en: The dated action is malicious marketplace distribution and removal, not a flaw in Claude’s model. The modified builds were not developed by Anthropic. Technical analysis identifies an attempted persistent SSH-access mechanism; actual success depends on host conditions and is not inferred for every downloader.
narrative.zhHans: 事件记录的是扩展市场的恶意版本分发与移除，不是 Claude 模型本身的缺陷。修改后的构建并非 Anthropic 开发。技术分析识别出尝试建立持久 SSH 访问的机制，但是否成功取决于主机条件，不能推断每位下载者都遭入侵。

text.en: On October 29, modified Claude Code extension builds were available in the Cursor marketplace for roughly 11 hours; Cursor removed them, and StepSecurity independently inspected the altered package.
text.zhHans: 10 月 29 日，被修改的 Claude Code 扩展构建在 Cursor 市场可获取约 11 小时；Cursor 随后移除，StepSecurity 独立检验了遭修改的扩展包。

text.en: Cursor reported no evidence that the official distribution or other extension versions were affected; its at-most-5,000 user estimate does not establish a number of compromised machines.
text.zhHans: Cursor 表示没有证据显示官方发行渠道或扩展的其他版本受影响；其“最多 5,000 名用户”的估计不能证明有多少设备实际遭入侵。
